tei:div.tei:p: "$ (53)༄༅// grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po la thugs rje chen pos dngos su gnang ba'i snying po yi ge drug pa'i nyams len gyi gzhung gsal byed dang bcas pa bzhugs so//

(54)༄༅// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐// 'dir yi dam thugs rje chen po dngos kyis grub thob chen po la dngos su gnang ba'i snying po yi ge drug ma/ chos thams cad kyi gsang mdzod gcig tu bsgril nas nyams su len pa'i tshul kun gyi 'gor ma nam mkha' ma'i gsol 'debs ci nus byas kha nang log gi dran pa'i zhal lce bas/ las snang 'gro drug gi rgyal khams la legs par brtags dus/ pha ma rigs drug gi 'char sgo thams cad mi bden rdzun pa'i rang bzhin/ skyo shas sdug bsngal gyi 'dam rdzab las ma 'das par shes pa'i nges 'byung kha gang po de ya dang por dpyad/ yang nang gses re re nas bltas dus/ dmyal ba la tsha grang btso sreg /yi dwags la bkres skom/ dud 'gro la gsod bkol/ lha la 'chi 'pho/ lha ma yin la 'thab rtsod/ mi la skye rga na 'chi'i chu bo bzhi myong bas grub pa 'dir 'dug snyam du 'khor ba la yid nges par 'byung ba'i dran pa nyag gcig gis rang ngo la cher te sbyar/ yang 'gyur ba'i rang zhal dran pa'i zhal lce bas/ sgos rang snang mi'i gnas tshul la brtags pas/ spyir skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal gyi khongs (55)su tshud/ sgos rang rang gis nyos pa'i dbang gis 'dus byas mtha' bzhi'i so 'phrang la thug nas 'dus pa'i mtha' 'bral/ bsags pa'i mtha' 'dzad/ mtho ba'i mtha' dma'/ skyes pa'i mtha' ma nges par 'chi snyam du blo thag chod kyi nges shes rtag tu bskyed do// de ltar mi rtag dran shes kyi lcag 'debs snying la thebs na/ nges 'byung dang dad pa kog lang du skye bas/ a tsa ma/ ngas mi lus nyin skar dang 'dra ba'i snang ba yud tsam 'di la lus kyi sgo nas ji ltar bgyis na rlabs po che'i dge ba zhig 'grub/ ngag gi sgo nas ji ltar smras na gzhan la phan pa'i dag pa la 'khul/ sems kyi sgo nas ji ltar bsam na sems can yongs la khyab ba'i dge bar 'gyur snyam du lus ngag yid gsum sems can gyi don du 'khol ba'i bsam sbyor rgya chen po bskyed do// don de dag 'grub ba'i phyir lha jo bo thugs rje chen po la gsol ba 'debs snyam pas mkha' khyab kyi dmigs pa la 'jug ste/

bdag sogs 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyi spyi bo'i gtsug tu pad+ma dkar po dang zla ba'i gdan la hrīḥlas 'khrungs pa'i (56)'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog sto na ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ nor bu chu shel ltar dwangs pa/ dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga ldan du 'phro ba/ chos thams cad de bzhin nyid du ro gcig pas zhal gcig pa/ kun la khyab ba'i byams brtse mnga' bas kun nas 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ dag pa'i spyan gyis dus drug tu gzigs pas ut+pala'i 'dab ma ltar rab tu rgyas pa'i spyan mnga' ba/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams sems can gyi don la bskul bar mdzad pas/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ thugs rje rgyun mi 'chad pas g.yas kyi gnyis pas shel dkar gyi phreng ba brgya rtsa brgyad 'dren tshul du bsnams pa/ rang don yid byed kyi 'dam gyis ma gos pas/ g.yon gyi gnyis pas pad+ma dkar po yu ba dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ khrel yod ngo tsha'i rang bzhin gyi ras bzang po'i sham thabs la nor bus brgyan pa'i ska rags kyis spras pa/ snying rje dang stong pa zung du 'jug pas zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ rnam thar brgyad kyi rang bzhin gyi rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis spras pa/ snying rje chen po'i nyams dang ldan pas ri dwags lpags pas stod g.yogs pa/ gsol ba 'debs pa'i yul bstan pa'i phyir rang gi bla ma 'od dpag med kyis ral pa'i thor tshugs mdzes par byas pa/ thugs rje chen po'i bsil zer gyis nyon mongs pa'i tsha gdung zhi bar mdzad pas dri med zla ba rgyas pa'i rgyab yol can no// bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dag dang 'brel bas bskyed rim legs par gsal btab nas/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad mgrin gcig tu gsol ba 'debs par mos la// jo bo skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis dbu la brgyan// thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs// spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes brjod pa'i rkyen gyis (57)'phags pa'i sku las 'od zer byung*/

snod thams cad la phog pas/ ma dag pa las snang gi 'char sgo sbyangs nas/ snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud kyi cha shas thams cad snang stong sku'i dkyil 'khor/ grags stong gsung gi dkyil 'khor/ gsal stong thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du gnas 'gyur ba'i ting nge 'dzin rgya 'byams dang 'brel bar yi ge drug pa longs skabs dang sbyar zhing*/ thun mthar chos nyid don gyi thugs rje chen po lha bde gshegs snying po'i rang ngo la gcer mthong rigs pa'i brda sbyor gyis yid zos bde nyams med par gzugs 'dzin gyi rgyu lam rbad kyis bcad la rang grol chen po'i ngang du lings kyis ci nus mnyam par bzhag go /thun mtshams su snying rjes kun nas blangs pa'i lus ngag yid gsum dge ba'i las la brtson par bya zhing*/ bsngo ba smon lam gyi rgyas 'debs bya/ brgyud pa'i rim pa yang*/ lha jo bo thugs rje chen po/ grub chen thang stong rgyal po/ kun spangs rje/ des bdag la'o/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' grol mchog /dge'o// ༈ grub pa'i dbang phyug lcags zam pa chen po'i nye brgyud yi ge drug pa'i sgom lung 'bog tshul gzhan phan mkha' khyab ces bya ba bzhugs so// na mo lo ke shwa ra ya// snyigs 'gro nyam thag skyong ba'i yab// 'jig rten dbang phyug brtson 'grus mtshan// gang gi gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin pa// 'gro mgon bla mar phyag byas nas// spyan ras gzigs dbang zhal gyi lung*// grub thob chen po'i khyad par chos// 'khor ba dong sprugs gdams ngag bcud// chos sgo brgyad khri'i snying po 'chad// 'dir 'brel tshad don lhan gyi bzang po spyod la zhugs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dag gis skal pa mchog dman ma brtags par thos pa tsam gyis phan yon snying la bzhags nas/ re ba dang zang zing med pa'i chos sbyin stsal bar 'dod pas/ 'dus pa'i dbus su (58)sems bskyed bzang po dang ldan pas chos kyi khri la 'khod/

grub na rang nyid kyis sgom bzlas mdor bsdus byas rjes/ /de 'di skad ces// 'o/ ma gyur nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob bar bya/ de'i ched du yi ge drug pa'i bsgom lung zab mo gsan la/ don tshul bzhin du nyams su len par bgyi'o snyam pa'i thugs bskyed rnam par dag pa dang ldan pa'i ngang nas/ sa phyogs 'di nyid dag pa'i zhing khams bde ba can/ slob dpon yang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dngos yin snyam pa'i 'du shes dang ldan pas/ lus kyis thal sbyar sogs gus pa'i tshul/ ngag gi ca co spangs shing sems gzhan du mi g.yengs par mnyan bya dam pa'i chos dang*/ de ston byed dge ba'i bshes gnyen la gus pa rtse gcig pas gsan par zhu// de'ang 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dang pad+ma 'byung gnas dbyer med rnal 'byor brtul zhugs spyod pa'i skur bstan pa grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po zhes mtshan nyi zla ltar grags pa de nyid/ sku gzhon nu'i tshe yig drug dung phyur gyi tshogs dpon mdzad pa'i dus na/ cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes brgyad kyi tho rangs kyi tshal/ sku mdun gyi bum pa'i kha rgyan de/ dpag bsam gyi sdong po chen por gyur ba'i yal 'dab kyi khrod du pad zla'i gdan bzhi brtsegs pa'i 'og nas yar rim bzhin 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ kha sar+pa ṇi/ rtsa phyag bzhi pa/ brgyad pa/ phyag stong spyan stong gi sku mtshan dpes brgyan pa 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na bzhengs stabs su bzhugs pa'i mtha' bskor du/ rta mgrin/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ sgrol ma/ rnam par rgyal ma/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis bskor ba/ 'og gi cha la phyogs skyongs bcu dang*/ gnod sbyin bcu gnyis/ rgyal chen bzhis bskor ba mngon sum du gzigs pas/ yan lag bdun pa'i mchod pa dang gsol (59)'debs mdzad pas/ rigs kyi bu khyod nam byang chub ma thob kyi bar du dge ba'i bshes gnyen nga yin pas/

yi ge drug pa'i sgo nas phrin las rgya chen po bsgrub cing*/ 'gro ba rnams 'dren par gyis shig /ces dang gdams pa mang du gsungs shing*/ gzhan yang lan du mar zhal dngos su bstan nas stsal ba'i gdams pa'i snying po/ zab la bde ba yi ge drug pa'i sgom bzlas kyi lung 'bogs shing nyams su len par byed pa la gsum/ sngon 'gro skyabs sems dang ldan pas blo chos la bskul ba/ dngos gzhi mkha' khyab kyi ting nge 'dzin dang 'brel bar bskyed bzlas rdzogs gsum bya ba/ rjes lam khyer gsum dang ldan pas dge rtsa gzhan don du bsngo ba'o// dang po ni// rang nyid gang du gnas pa'i mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che'i khri dang pad zla'i gdan la/ ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid rnam pa spyan ras gzigs 'gro 'dul phyag bzhi pa'i skur gsal ba'i 'khor du sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pas bskor te bzhugs pa'i mdun du/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung rdzogs pa'i byang chub ma thob kyi bar du snying thag pa nas skyabs su 'gro snyam pa'i blo rtse gcig pas skyabs 'gro'i tshig lcags zam pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs 'gro dgu skor du grags pa thugs rje chen pos ka lnga pa dpal 'byor shes rab la gsungs nas grub chen la gnang bar bka' bsgos pa ltar bstsal ba'i byin brlabs myong grub kyis che ba 'di la bya ste// gong du ji skad bshad pa ltar dmigs pa rtse gcig pas skyabs 'gro'i tshig 'di lhan cig tu gnang bar zhu// ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi'o// rang sems stong gsal chos kyi sku la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes brgya rtsa (60)nyer gcig /bdun la sogs pa sgom lung 'bogs skabs tshar gsum bdun gang rung lhan cig tu brjod pa'am rjes zlos bya ste 'og ma rnams la'ang shes par bya'o

longs khyab dang sbyar te brjod pa'i rjes su/ skyabs yul 'od du zhu/ rang la thim pas thugs rje'i byin rlabs zhugs/ blo chos su ngang gis 'gro zhing bar chad med par bsam/ de'i rjes thob tu/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i pha ma sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor dus rtag tu khyams pa snying re rje/ 'di rnams thams cad bdag kho nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god par bya/ de'i nus pa bdag la med pas chos thams cad kyi snying po yi ge drug pa'i sgom bzlas nyams su blangs la myur ba nyid du sems can rnams dgrol bar bya snyam pa mnyan pa'am phyugs rdzi lta bu'i sems bskyed dang ldan pas/ ngag tu 'di gsung bar zhu/ sems can thams cad yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i sgom bzlas nyams su blang bgyi'o// zhes grangs su brjod cing lhag bsam bzang po rgyud la 'gre nges bya/ skyabs 'gro thog mar byas pas sdom pa thams cad kyi rten du 'gyur/ blo chos su 'gro/ lam sgrub pa la bar chad mi 'byung*/ sems bskyed pas de phyin chad bsam sbyor ci byas byang chub kyi grogs su 'gyur bas chos lam du 'gro ba'i dgos pa yod do/ de nas kha nang du log pa'i dran pas blo chos su bskul ba la gsum/ nges 'byung gi gzhi bting ba/ brtson 'grus kyi lcag skul ba/ phyugs rdzi lta ba'i sems bskyed kyi mtshams sbyar ba'o// dang po la spyi dang bye brag tu dpyad pa gnyis las/ spyir thog ma med pa nas bdag med pa la bdag tu bzung ste rgyu ma rig pa/ rkyen las dang nyon mongs pas bskyed pa'i 'gro ba rigs drug gi snang ba 'di rnams la dpyad pas/ rmi lam gyi dgra gnyen nam sgyu ma'i rgyal srid ltar rang ngos nas bden par grub pa rdul phra mo (61)tsam med kyang*/ 'khrul snang mi bden par bzung ste/

nyon mongs pa bag nyal gyis khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal/ bde ba ltar snang yang myur du mi rtag pa 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal/ las ngan pa'i 'bras bu mngon du spyod pa sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal te/ dper na til la snum gyis khyab pa bzhin du khams gsum rigs drug gi sems can rnams sdug bsngal chen po de gsum las ma 'das pas 'khor ba'i 'dir bde ba skra rtse'i cha shas tsam yang med pa las bsams te nges 'byung drag tu bskyed/ bye brag rigs drug re re nas dpyad de/ de'ang mdo sde dran pa nyer bzhag las// sems can dmyal ba dmyal mes nyams// yi dwags bkres shing skom pas nyams// dud 'gro gcig la gcig zas nyams// lha dag bag med pa yis nyams// lha min 'thab cing rtsod pas nyams// mi dag 'tsho ba thung pas nyams// 'khor ba khab kyi rtse tsam yang*// bde ba nam yang yod ma yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar srid rtse nas mnar med par 'khor ba'i gnas mtho dman gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal kho na'i rang bzhin/ dper na dug dang 'dres pa'i kha zas la rnam pa bzang ngan gyi khyad par med pas spang bar bya ba bzhin du 'khor ba las nges par 'byung ba'i blo brtan por bskyed par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ de dag las kyang khyad par du rang re mi'i gnas snang 'di la dpyad pas/ mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad du ma skyes pas dal ba brgyad/ rang 'byor lnga/ gzhan 'byor lnga ste dal 'byor gyi chos bco brgyad dang ldan pa'i mi'i lus rnyed pa shin tu dka' zhing*/ rnyed na phan thogs che bas rin po che dang chos mtshungs pas 'di nyid rgyu dang dpe dang grangs sogs kyi sgo nas thob par dka' ste/ ngan song gi 'gro ba sa chen po'i rdul tsam yod la mi lus tsam po pa'ang sen mo'i steng gi rdul dang 'dra bar yod pa las/ chos ldan gyi mi (62)lus ni nyin mo'i skar ma ltar dkon te/ snying rje pad dkar las// mir skye pa ni rnyed par dka'// dal ba phun sum tshogs pa'ang rnyed par dka'/

sangs rgyas 'jig rten du 'byung ba'ang rnyed par dka'/ dge ba'i chos la 'dun pa'ang rnyed par dka'/ yang dag pa'i smon lam yang rnyed par dka' ba lags so// zhes sogs mtha' yas pa gsungs la/ de lta bu'i mi lus thob kyang skye rga na 'chi'i chu bo chen po bzhi las ma 'das pas rtag pa dang bde ba skad cig kyang med/ de'ang spyir 'dus byas thams cad kyang mi rtag pa'i mtha' bzhis dbang du byas pa ste 'dus pa'i mthar 'bral/ bsags pa'i mthar 'dzad/ mtho ba'i mthar dma'/ skyes pa'i mthar nges par 'chi/ sgos mi'i lus nam 'chi'i cha med cing 'chi rkyen gang gis kyang byed nges pa med/ gsod sar khrid pa'i btson bzhin zhag re song ba dang 'chi ba la je nyer 'gro/ chu'i chu bur/ ri gzar gyi rbab/ nam mkha'i glog ltar glo bur myur ba kho nar 'chi ba thog tu 'ong*/ mkhas btsun btsan phyug dpa' rtsal mo gto sman dpyad gang gis kyang bzlog tu med/ longs spyod dbang thang snyan grags gang yang rjes su mi 'brang bas dge sdig gi las kho na rnam par shes pa dang 'grogs nas tshe phyi ma'i gnas su 'gro ba'i tshe sdig pas ngan song du ltung*/ dge bas mtho ris dang thar ba thob pa yin pas des na tshe phyi ma phan chad la phan pa dam pa'i chos ma gtogs gcig kyang med/ tshe phyi ma lta ci smos/ tshe 'di la'ang 'phral yun gnyis kar phan pa che ba dam pa'i chos kho na yin cing*/ sang byed gnangs byed kyi long skabs med pas da lta nyid nas las 'bras la yid ches pa'i dad pa dang*/ bla ma dkon mchog la sems dwangs pa'i dad pa dang*/ byang chub bsgrub pa la 'dod pa'i dad pa ste/ de gsum dang ldan pas lus la g.yog dang gru yi 'du shes bzhag ste dam pa'i chos kho na la mi 'bung re snyam pa'i dam bca' brtan par bya'o// gsum pa ni/ (63)yang 'di snyam du bsam ste/ a tsa ma// bdag gis mi lus nyin mo'i snang ba dang 'dra ba yud tsam pa 'di la lus kyi sgo nas ji ltar bgyis na rlabs po che'i dge ba zhig 'grub/

ngag gi sgo nas ji ltar smras na gzhan la phan pa'i dge ba la 'khul/ yid kyi sgo nas ji ltar bsam na sems can yongs la khyab pa'i dge bar 'gyur snyam du mdor na lus ngag yid gsum sems can don du bkol ba'i lhag bsam rgya chen po bskyed/ don de dag 'grub pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying rje'i rang gzugs/ bod kha ba can gyi lha skal/ jo bo thugs rje chen po la gsol ba 'debs so snyam pas mkha' khyab kyi dmigs pa la 'jug go /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ bskyed rim bsgom pa/ bzlas pa bya ba/ rdzogs rim bsgom pa'o// dang po ni// bdag sogs 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyi spyi bo'i gtsug tu pad+ma dkar po dang zla ba'i gdan la yi ge hrīḥlas 'khrungs pa'i 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog ston kha'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ nor bu chu shel ltar dwangs pa/ dri ma med pa'i 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan du 'phro ba/ chos thams cad de bzhin nyid du ro gcig pas zhal gcig pa/ kun la khyab pa'i byams brtse mnga' bas kun nas 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ dag pa'i spyan gyis dus drug tu gzigs pas ut+pa la'i 'dab ma ltar rab tu rgyas pa'i spyan mnga' ba/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams sems can gyi don du bskul bar mdzad pas phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ thugs rje'i rgyun mi 'chad pa'i brdar g.yas kyi gnyis pa shel dkar gyi phreng ba brgya rtsa brgyad 'dren tshul du bsnams pa/ rang don yid byed kyi 'dam gyis ma gos pas g.yon gyi gnyis pas pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa yu ba dang bcas pa snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba 'dzin pa/ khrel yod ngo tsha'i rang bzhin gyi ras bzang po'i sham thabs (64)la nor bus brgyan pa'i ska rags kyis spras pa/ snying rje dang stong pa zung du 'jug pa zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ rnam thar brgyad kyi rang bzhin rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis spras pa/

snying rje chen po'i nyams dang ldan pas ri dwags kyi pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ gsol ba 'debs pa'i yul bstan pa'i phyir rang gi bla ma 'od dpag med kyis ral pa'i thor tshugs kyi ngos la mdzes par brgyan pa/ thugs rje chen po'i bsil zer gyis nyon mongs pa'i tsha gdung zhi bar mdzad pas dri med zla ba rgyas ba'i rgyab yol can/ rtsa brgyud bla ma/ yi dam lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang sems kun 'dus kyi ngo bor bzhugs pa la/ bdag dang 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyis gus pa chen pos gsol ba 'debs bar mos la 'di gsung bar zhu// jo bo skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis dbu la brgyan// thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs// spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa'i gsol 'debs ci nus dang*/ spro na/ grub thob nyid dge slong pad+ma dkar por skye ba bzhes pa'i tshe spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba btab pa'i rdo rje'i gsung byin brlabs can dang*/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rnams kyang bya// gnyis pa ni// de ltar gsol ba btab pas/ spyi bo'i 'phags pa'i sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad la phog pas/ ma dag las snang gi 'char sgo sbyangs te/ snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang*/ bcud kyi sems can thams cad lus snang stong dbyer med 'phags pa'i sku'i rang bzhin/ ngag grags stong dbyer med yi ge drug ma'i rang sgra/ yid rig stong dbyer med ye shes kyi rol pa ste snang grags rtog gsum dkyil 'khor gsum du gnas bsgyur ba'i mkha' khyab kyi ting nge 'dzin rgya 'byams kyi ngang du yid rtse gcig pas yi ge drug pa'i bzlas pa lhan cig tu gnang bar zhu// (65)oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/

bzlas lung pas 'dir yig drug brgya rtsa sogs gang 'os gsung srol yod gsungs/ /zhes yi ge drug pa'i bzlas brjod ji tsam nus pa bya// gsum pa ni// sgom bzlas grub pa'i mthar/ rang sems gsal stong rig pa'i snying po can// chos nyid don gyi thugs rje chen po sku gsum gdod nas rang chas su grub pa/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i gnas skabs kun khyab bde gshegs snying po'i rang zhal la/ gnyug ma'i rig pas blta bya lta byed ma grub pa'i ngang du gcer gyis blta/ bzo bcos dgag sgrub kyi yid dpyod dang bral/ bde gsal mi rtog pa sogs nyams kyi 'dzin stangs la ma zhen/ rnam rtog gzugs 'dzin gyi 'gyu lam rbad kyis bcad de/ rtog pa'i 'phro 'du byung yang chos nyid gnyug ma'i ngang du rang zhi rang grol du btang nas spros bral gyi gnas lugs la ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag go /gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni// mnyam bzhag de las ldang bar 'dod na/ slar rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs gyi sku snang la rang bzhin med par gyur par mos la/ dgra gnyen bar mas bsdus pa'i 'gro ba thams cad la chags sdang rmongs gsum gyis 'dor len mi bya bar gzugs su snang ba thams cad 'phags pa'i sku'i rang bzhin/ sgra skad grags tshad yi ge drug pa'i rang sgra/ bzang ngan gyi dran rtog ci shar ye shes chen por thag bcad de rtog pa'i ro mi myong ba gang shar de ka'i ngo bo la had de 'jog pa ste khyer so gsum gyi rnal 'byor dang ma bral ba'i ngos/ 'khrul snang la bden par bzung ba'i pha ma sems can ris su ma chad pa la byams dang snying rjes kun nas bslangs te/ bden zhen bral ba sgyu ma'i tshul gyis lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas dge ba'i bya ba ci nus su 'bad/ de lta bu'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyang rab 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i tshul/ 'bring bden med sgyu ma'i blo/ tha ma rgyal ba sras bcas kyi (66)rjes su slob pa'i bsam pas sems can gyi don du bsngo ba 'di lhan cig tu gnang bar zhu// de ltar du bgyis ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di la brten nas bdag dang pha ma sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thob par gyur cig

/ces pa dang*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /spyan ras gzigs dbang 'grub gyur nas// sogs bsngo smon rnam par dag bas rgyas 'debs par bya'o// des bsgom lung gi rim pa zab mo legs par gsan ba yin pas/ ji ltar phog pa'i dmigs bzlas/ de lta bu rab thun bzhi'i rim pas khor yug /'bring sgom bzlas thun re chags med/ thams cad zhag bdun gyi mtha' brten pa'i nyams len byas pa'i phan yon ni/ sdig sgrib nyon mongs dag /snying rje dang rtogs pa 'char/ gzhan don rgya chen po 'grub/ phyi ma bde ba can du skyes nas myur du 'tshang rgya ba sogs smos kyis mi longs pa mdo rgyud bstan bcos mtha' dag nas gsungs pas tshegs chung la don che ba'i gdams pa 'di nyid rang don du rtse gcig nyams su len pa dang*/ gzhan la 'chad cing spel ba dang*/ tha na srog chags grog sbur tshun chad kyi rna bar thugs rje chen po'i mtshan dang yig drug sgrogs la 'khor ba dong sprugs 'brel tshad don ldan don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i lam bzang mthar dbyung bar zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa sogs kyis bsngo smon pas la 'dus pa gyis so// sgom bzlas yid la dran tsam gyis/ mtshams med sgrib pa zad byed cing*/ khyad par gangs can mgon gcig pu// de sgrub gdams ngag gsal bshad pas// mthong thos dran reg skye dgu kun// 'od snang mtha' yas zhing khams su// 'jig rten mgon pos dbugs dbyung ste// gang gi rnam thar kun 'grub shog /ces pa'ang dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje dang ldan pa rje btsun mañdzu gho ṣa'i gsung zer bdud rtsis snying gi pad+mor dran pas/ yig drug (67)pa blo gros mtha' yas kyis rtsa ba'i yig snying gi dgongs pa gsal bar phyes/ lcags zam pa'i khrid yig ma bu'i bcud bsdus te/ lhag pa'i bsam pas dpal spungs yang khrod du sbyar bas gzhan phan nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur cig

/dge legs 'phel// ༈ /grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po'i nye brgyud thugs rje chen po'i sgom bzlas kyi ngag 'don mdo sngags yongs bcud ces bya ba bzhugs so/// bla ma thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir grub chen lcags zam pa chen po'i nye brgyud thun mongs ma yin pa'i thugs rje chen po'i sgom bzlas nyams su len pa la/ thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba ni// rang mdun nam mkha' rin chen khri// pad+ma zla ba'i gdan steng du// ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid// rnam pa mgon po spyan ras gzigs// sangs rgyas byang sems tshogs kyis bskor// mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs par gyur// ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun rnams la= /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la= /rang sems stong gsal chos kyi sku la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes grangs ci nus bsags la/ mthar/ skyabs yul 'od zhu rang la thim/ sems bskyed pa ni// sems can thams cad yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum/ de nas blo chos su skul ba ni// 'di ltar 'jigs pa thams cad dang*// sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa yang*// sems las byung ba yin no zhes// yang dag gsung pa nyid kyis bstan// lcags bsregs sa gzhi su yis byas// me tshogs de dag gang las byung*// des na de dag thams cad ni// sdig sems lags par thub (68)pas gsungs// 'gro ba 'di dag thams cad ni// rtag tu ma skyes ma 'gag nyid// 'gro ba rmi lam lta bu ste// rnam par dpyad na chu shing 'dra// sems can dmyal ba dmyal mes nyams// yi dwags bkres shing skom pas nyams// dud 'gro gcig la gcig zas nyams// lha dag bag med pa yis nyams// lha min 'thab cing rtsod pas nyams// mi dag 'tsho ba thung bas nyams// 'khor ba khab kyi rtse tsam yang*// bde ba nam yang yod ma yin// rgya mtsho cher g.yeng gnya' shing gi

/bu gar ru sbal mgrin chud ltar// mi nyid rnyed pa shin tu dka'// kye ma 'dus byas rnams mi rtag /skye zhing 'jig pa'i chos can yin// bsags pa kun gyi mtha' mdzad cing*// bslang ba'i tha ma 'gyel bar 'gyur// 'phrad ba'i tha ma 'bral ba ste// gson pa'i tha ma 'chi bar 'gyur// de ring kho nar mi 'chi zhes// bde bar 'dug pa rigs ma yin// 'jig rten bde ba ji snyed pa// de kun gzhan bde 'dod las byung*// 'jig rten sdug bsngal ji snyed pa// de kun rang bde 'dod las byung*// bdag nyid skyon bcas gzhan dag la// yon tan rgya mtshor shes byas nas// 'gro ba thams cad srung sems dang*// snying rje'i sems ni goms par bya// de bas mgon po spyan ras gzigs// thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba yi// 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa'ang bsal ba'i phyir// rang gi mtshan yang byin gyis brlabs// sku yi dkyil 'khor gcig bsgoms pas// sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa ni// mgon po spyan ras gzigs sku yin// bsgoms dang yid la dran pas kyang*// mtshams med sgrib pa 'dag par byed// des na rtse gcig sgom bzlas pa// zhes pa'i tshig rnams ngag tu brjod pa'am// mi spro na don yid la bsam// de nas mkha' khyab kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa ni// bdag sogs mkha' khyab sems can gyi// spyi (69)gtsug pad dkar zla ba'i steng*// hrīḥlas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs// dkar gsal 'od zer lnga ldan 'phro// 'dzum ldan thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// phyag bzhi'i dang po thal sbyar mdzad// 'og gnyis shel phreng pad dkar bsnams// dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras// ri dwags lpags pa'i stod g.yogs gsol// 'od dpag med pa'i dbu rgyan can// zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs// dri med zla bar rgyab brten pa// skyabs gnas kun 'dus ngo bor gyur// bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu gsol ba 'debs par bsams la// jo bo skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis dbu la brgyan// thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs// spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/

/zhes ci nus bsags/ /spro na// dge slong pad+ma dkar po'i thugs dam spyan ras gzigs kyi gsol 'debs dang*/ bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyang gsung rgyun la kha skong ba/ gangs can 'gro ba'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs// grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po'i zhabs// rdo rje 'dzin pa kun spangs chos kyi rje// gsol ba 'debs so 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs// byin gyis rlobs shig yi dam thugs rje can// byams dang snying rje 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐// kun dga'i rtsal rdzogs sems kyi mdun grol mchog /bstan 'dzin nyi zla mkhas btsun bzang po'i phul// grub pa'i rigs 'chang ngag dbang nyid ma'i mtshan// gsol ba 'debs so sogs tshig rkang gsum po sngags bcas 'gro/ bshad sgrub bstan 'dzin bsod nams dbang phyug dang*// mkhas shing dngos grub mchog brnyes rmor chen rje// bsod nams ye shes mchog tu grub pa'i dpal// (70)gsol ba 'debs so= /yongs rdzogs bstan 'dzin ye shes lhun gyis grub// blo bzang rgyal sras lung rtogs bstan pa 'phel// grub bstan 'dzin mchog mkhyen rab mthu stobs bdag /gsol ba= /'jam dbyangs gzhon nu bshes gnyen mchog gi tshul// mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug bdag nyid chen po dang*// rtsa brgyud bla ma bka' drin can rnams la// gsol ba= /byin gyis rlobs shig= /byams dang snying rje 'byongs par= mkha' khyab rig 'dzin brnyes par byin gyis rlobs// snang srid chos skur 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// don gnyis mtha' ru phyin par byin gyis rlobs// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐// de ltar rtse gcig gsol btab pas// 'phags pa'i sku las 'od zer 'phros// ma dag las snang 'khrul shes sbyangs// phyi snod bde ba can gyi zhing*// nang bcud skye 'gro'i lus ngag sems// spyan ras gzigs dbang sku gsung thugs// snang grags rig stong dbyer med gyur// zhes pa'i don la mnyam par bzhag bzhin tu yi ge drug pa bzla ba ni mkha' khyab kyi rnal 'byor dngos yin pas// 'di'i mthar rdzogs rim la 'jug pa ni rtsa ba'i dgongs pa yin la/

gal te kun spangs yab sras kyi gsung rgyun ltar bzlas dmigs spyi mthun sbyar ba spro na/ spyi bo'i 'gro mgon 'od du zhu// rang gzhan la thim thugs ka ru// pad dkar 'dab drug lte bar hrīḥ /yig 'bru nang bstan g.yas bskor bas// 'od 'phros 'gro kun sdig sgrib sbyangs// byang chub sems gnyis rgyud la skyes// slar 'dus bdag rgyud byin brlabs gyur// zhes mos la yig drug bzla/ thun mthar rdzogs rim ni// bsgom med sgom pa po yang med// lha med sngags kyang yod ma yin// 'di la bsal bya ci yang med// bzhag par bya ba cung zad med// yang dag nyid la yang dag blta// yang dag mthong na rnam par grol// gang skyes gnyug ma nyid yin phyir// gang shar dran pas sor bzhag na// (71)de shar stong pa nyid dag tu// rnal 'byor rgyal po gdon mi za// zhes pa'i tshig ngag tu brjod pa'am don bsam la gnas lugs gnyug ma'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag /de las ldang bar 'dod na// bdag gzhan lus snang 'phags pa'i sku// sgra grags yi ge drug pa'i dbyangs// dran rtog ye shes chen po'i klong*// dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /spyan ras gzigs dbang 'grub gyur sogs dang*/ 'di ltar sgom bzlas bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// bdag dang bdag la 'brel thogs 'gro ba kun// mi gtsang lus= /bde ba can du= /skyes ma thag tu= /sprul pas phyogs bcur= /'jam dpal dpa' bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ sangs rgyas sku gsum sogs bsngo smon rnam par dag pas rgyas gdab par bya'o// zhes pa'ang thar 'dod yongs la sman pa'i bsam pa rgyur byas te/ blo gros mtha' yas kyis dpal spungs yang khrod du bris pa dge legs 'phel// ༈ /rje grub thob chen po dge slong pad+ma dkar por skye ba bzhes pa'i tshe 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba btab pa'i rdo rje'i gsung bzhugs so// gsol ba 'debs so bla ma spyan ras gzigs// gsol ba 'debs so yi dam spyan ras gzigs// gsol ba 'debs so 'phags mchog=

/gsol ba 'debs so skyabs mgon= /gsol ba 'debs so byams mgon= /thugs rje zungs shig rgyal ba thugs rje can// mtha' med 'khor bar grangs med 'khyams gyur cing*// bzod med sdug bsngal myong ba'i 'gro ba la// mgon po khyed las skyabs gzhan ma mchis so// rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis rlobs// thog med dus nas las ngan bsags pa'i mthus// zhe sdang dbang gis dmyal bar skyes gyur te// tsha grang sdug bsngal myong ba'i sems can rnams// lha mchog khyed kyi drung du skye bar shog /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐// (72)thog med dus nas las ngan bsags pa'i mthus// ser sna'i dbang gis yi dwags gnas su skyes// bkres skom sdug bsngal myong ba'i sems can rnams// zhing mchog po tā la ru skye bar shog /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐// thogs med dus nas= /gti mug dbang gis dud 'gror skyes gyur te// glen lkug sdug bsngal myong ba'i sems can rnams// mgon po khyed kyi drung du skye bar shog /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐// thog med dus nas las ngan bsags pa'i mthus// phrag dog dbang gis lha min gnas su skyes// 'thab rtsod sdug bsngal myong ba'i sems can rnams// po tā la yi zhing du skye bar shog /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐// thog med dus nas las ngan bsags pa'i mthus// nga rgyal dbang gis lha yi gnas su skyes// 'pho ltung sdug bsngal myong ba'i sems can rnams// po tā la yi zhing du skye bar shog /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐// bdag ni skye zhing skye ba thams cad du// spyan ras gzigs dang mdzad pa mtshungs pa yis// ma dag zhing gi 'gro rnams sgrol ba dang*// gsung mchog yig drug phyogs bcur rgyas par shog /'phags mchog khyed la gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// bdag gi gdul byar gyur ba'i pa'i 'gro ba rnams// las 'bras lhur len dge ba'i las la brtson// 'gro ba'i don du chos dang ldan par shog

/ces pa 'di ni grub chen thang stong rgyal pos rje rang gi skye ba gong ma dge slong pad+ma dkar por 'khrungs pa'i skabs/ dgung lo nyi shu nas brgyad cu'i bar du smyung bar gnas las 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la rtse gcig tu gsol ba btab pa'i tshig 'di sngon gnas rjes dran tu gsungs ba ste/ byin rlabs kyi tshan ka mchog dang ldan pa lags so/// /maṅga lam/// /
